We still haven't succeeded. Maybe the level requires pressing SPACE when the view shows the c bar aligned with the W row? Currently the c bar is far below. Could be that we need to scroll such that the c bar is exactly over the W row (i.e., the c bar appears in same view as W row). That would happen when we scroll so that the c bar is near top of view. Let's try moving up a lot (if possible) to bring c bar up. But c bar is at bottom of level; moving up will bring it up. Let's move UP many times (maybe 20) to bring c bar into view near top.
We'll do UP 20.
